newsitem.title: UK: Business remains routine in European cotton market.
newsitem.headline: Business remains routine in European cotton market.

text.p: Business in raw cotton in most European markets has continued the recent pattern, traders said.
Mills have concentrated their attention on covering outstanding gaps in nearby shipment requirements and have for the most part disregarded their potential forward needs.
As customary, Central Asian styles have continued to be well favoured particularly as some sellers' asking rates for these descriptions have tended of late to weaken.
Some attention has also been paid to selected US styles, notably Germany.
